name: well_formed
rationale: A conforming program produces no diagnostics at all.

name: missing_exclusion
rationale: Thm 4.3: a positive description alone does not determine a target, so a seek without `excluding` is a form the language does not contain. Rejected at parse time, before typing.

name: zero_floor
rationale: T-Seek-Pos: a program may not assert an attainable zero residual.

name: negative_floor
rationale: T-Seek-Pos again, with a floor below zero rather than at it.

name: two_catalysts
rationale: T-Seek-Coh: no support structure shorter than three survives the loss of a member (a 1-cycle is vacuous, a 2-cycle collapses).

name: not_mutually_independent
rationale: T-Seek-Coh checks the independence relation, not merely the count: three catalysts that are not pairwise declared independent fail.

name: unknown_catalyst_in_via
rationale: A via clause naming a catalyst that was never declared.

name: duplicate_catalyst_in_via
rationale: Naming one catalyst twice does not make a triad.

name: independence_names_unknown
rationale: An independence declaration referring to a catalyst that does not exist is unverifiable in a way the checker can detect.

name: report_unbound
rationale: Reporting a name that was never bound.

name: no_substrate
rationale: Without a substrate there is no floor obligation for a seek to satisfy.

name: missing_substrate_field
rationale: The four obligations are positional; a missing one is named.

name: unterminated_string
rationale: Lexical: a string literal running to end of line.

name: unexpected_character
rationale: Lexical: a character no token may begin with.
source:
substrate Osc { receivers : r(); observable : o(); events : e(); floor : asymptotic(); }
let x @ y;

name: no_via_clause_is_legal
rationale: T-Seek-Coh applies only to an explicit chain, so omitting `via` is well typed — the rule constrains what is named, not that anything is.
